messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: multivariate normal cdf
parts:
To give suggestions on this I think we need to know something about the covariance matrix dimension or other structural properties that might be relevant.
Would a Monte Carlo method be feasible? FWIW, a 1D Monte Carlo version of 'pnorm' could be made like this:

mcpnorm <- function(x) {
  N <- 1e3
  u <- rnorm(N)
  sum(plogis( 10 * (x - u) )) / N
}
F <- MakeTape(mcpnorm, 0)
F <- F$atomic() ## Can now be used from other tapes with little memory usage
